references.text: Gershon is mentioned as one of Levi's sons, and this verse introduces the counting of his descendants
The family of Libni is mentioned again in the second census of the Levites, as descendants of Gershon
Libni and Shimei are named as Gershon's sons in the genealogy in Exodus 2
Libni and Shimei are named as Gershon's sons in the genealogical records of Chronicles
The families of the Gershonites, including the family of Libni, are mentioned in connection with David's organization of the Levites
Gershon is mentioned as Levi's son when Jacob's family went down to Egypt
